subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: The QA Career Path
description: A fast breakdown of The QA Career Path for builders.

hook.text: A junior tester wonders: is QA a dead-end job? Actually, it's one of the fastest-evolving roles in tech.

buildup.text: QA careers range from manual tester to automation engineer, QA architect, and engineering manager.

discovery.text: Specializations include performance testing, security testing, accessibility, and test infrastructure.

twist.text: The 'QA engineer' title is fading. Many companies now call it 'quality engineer' or 'SET'—software engineer in test.

climax.text: Top QA professionals earn as much as senior developers because quality expertise is scarce and valuable.

punchline.text: QA isn't a stepping stone. It's a destination career.
